rubric: Firebase security-rules-auditor skill 1-5 rubric; engineering assessment only, not certification
summary: Profile protections pass but consultation create/update permit forged participant identity and owner reassignment under retrieved production source.

findings.issue: Authenticated patient can create consultation with another patientUserId; target can read injected record.
findings.recommendation: Centralize consultation writes behind server-authorized commands or specify equivalent bounded client rules.

findings.issue: Existing owner can change createdBy and patientUserId through direct update.
findings.recommendation: Keep creator, patient and encounter ownership immutable; add positive and negative regressions.

findings.issue: Consultation client create/update do not define an application field/type/size schema. No resource-exhaustion workload was run.
findings.recommendation: Define a bounded schema if client writes remain permitted.

checklist.businessPurpose: FAIL: server role boundary not mirrored by database
checklist.storageAbuse: Source observation: consultation schema lacks application bounds; load not tested
checklist.typeSafety: Source observation: consultation fields other than create owner not typed
checklist.fieldAndIdentityScope: Old-owner check exists, new identity fields unrestricted
